title: 2026 so far
tagline: A phone payment for nearly everything, a home-won World Cup and a census begun: India to 18 October.

morningRoutine.detail: India had about 1,360.7 million telephone connections at the end of August 2026, mostly wireless, about 1,312 million.

morningRoutine.detail: UPI handled an average of about 802 million transactions a day in September 2026, the first month above 800 million a day.

morningRoutine.detail: Food prices were 7.74 percent higher in September 2026 than a year earlier, by the official consumer food price index.

places.title: The front page
places.description: A cricket World Cup won at home, a global AI summit in Delhi and a new tax law.
places.imageAlt: A news app with the World Cup win and the AI summit
highlights: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs to win the men's T20 World Cup (8 March)
Delhi hosts the AI Impact Summit (16 to 20 February)
The new Income-tax Act, 2025 takes effect (1 April)

More than a billion broadband connections

technology.description: TRAI counted 1,101 million broadband connections at the end of August 2026, 1,053 million of them wireless, with about 13.45 million on 5G fixed wireless.

technology.name: Indian-language AI models
technology.description: At the AI Impact Summit in February 2026, Sarvam AI showed 30B and 105B models and the government-backed BharatGen released Param2, which covers 22 Indian languages.

source.label: Wikipedia: AI Impact Summit

technology.name: Quick commerce
technology.description: Delivery apps such as Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart bring groceries to the door in minutes; in January 2026 Blinkit dropped its '10 minutes' tagline after talks with the Labour Ministry.

source.label: The Week: Blinkit stops '10 minute' delivery claim; Zepto follows suit (13 January 2026)

technology.name: Noida International Airport
technology.description: The first phase of Noida International Airport (Jewar) was inaugurated on 28 March 2026 and the first commercial flight landed on 15 June 2026.
